_note: 2_02 'Comic Klepto' — a thief grabs the comic-shop owner's rarest comic and flees across the Vale; chase him down, beat the comic loose, and bring it back (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_02-comic-klepto.md; identification INFERRED-strong there — 2_02 embeds no title string, but pedKlepto/item 504/the comic-shop clerk 84 nail it). Chapter placement: our catalog lists Comic Klepto in chapter 3, but the script lives in chap2/ — the engine mapping is authoritative here (same contradiction pattern as 1_S01/2_S04, flagged in the campaign row). The 2_02_Conv.lua companion (docs/re-notes/ch2/2_02_conv-comic-flags.md) is ported as two mission-blackboard flags per the recon's framework note: set_flag 2_02_got_comic when the comic is recovered (the F_PlayerGotComicCond read side) and set_flag 2_02_returned_comic at the hand-off (the F_PlayerSetReturnedComic write side); the .act conversation tree that consumed them is out of scope. v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the mounted bike chase is a foot chase (no vehicle bundle: no spawn_vehicle/mount/dismount — the klepto sprints the escape route and the player runs); the two-tier distance leash (50 m one-shot warning, 75 m instant fail) is our single leash (75 m held 5 s); the school-parking scripted escape folds into that leash fail; the full 123-node NEWESCAPE loop is compressed to its first half with a fixed corner point (the original is KO-anywhere along the route; the corner is waypoint 54 where the route bends back from New Coventry); the dismount->on-foot behavior swap is the corner fight (he turns and fights, hits_to_beat 3 for the original's x1.5 locked health + stat overrides); his named health bar is the boss_bar; weapon 301 is skipped (the original clears it on dismount anyway); the owner's delete+respawn at the stage change is skipped (he just waits); ambient-vehicle clearing and the distance-driven music-tier switching are skipped (no interactive music system); item 362's mystery escape drop is skipped (OPEN in the recon). No SMissPass branch exists for 2_02 (VERIFIED absence) — the dorm-decoration reward is OPEN there. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes.
title: Comic Klepto

stages.objective: Someone just robbed the comic shop.

lines.speaker: SHOP OWNER
lines.text: That little creep just walked out with my rarest issue! Get it back and there's a reward in it for you!

on_start.text: Don't let him get too far ahead!

stages.fail_text: The klepto got away with the comic.

stages.objective: He's cornered. Take the comic back.

on_complete.speaker: KLEPTO
on_complete.text: Okay, okay! Take the stupid comic!

stages.objective: Return the comic to the shop owner.

on_complete.speaker: SHOP OWNER
on_complete.text: My precious! You have a talent for retail recovery, kid.
